messages.content: Give me an analysis trail for my project id SUPERFANCY with component UUID AB1010CD and vulnerability ef903ac-893-f00

function.name: analysis_api_AnalysisApi_retrieve_analysis
function.description: Retrieves the analysis trail associated with a specified vulnerability within a component of a project. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project.description: The UUID of the project to which the analysis trail belongs.

component.description: The UUID of the component within the project being analyzed.

vulnerability.description: The UUID of the vulnerability for which the analysis trail is retrieved.

function.name: finding_api_FindingApi_analyze_project
function.description: Initiates a vulnerability analysis for the specified project using its unique identifier (UUID). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the project for which the vulnerability analysis is to be triggered.

function.name: violationanalysis_api_retrieve_analysis
function.description: Retrieves the details of a violation analysis trail for a given component and policy violation by their UUIDs. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

component.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the component for which the analysis trail is to be retrieved.

policyViolation.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the policy violation associated with the component.

function.name: VulnerabilityApi_get_vulnerabilities_by_component
function.description: Retrieves a list of all identified vulnerabilities associated with a specific software component, allowing for optional inclusion of suppressed vulnerabilities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The universally unique identifier (UUID) of the software component for which vulnerabilities are being queried.

suppressed.description: A flag to determine whether suppressed vulnerabilities should be included in the response. Suppressed vulnerabilities are those that have been flagged as false positives or accepted risks.

function.name: VulnerabilityApi_get_vulnerabilities_by_project
function.description: Retrieve a list of all identified vulnerabilities associated with a given project using its unique identifier (UUID). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the project for which the vulnerabilities are being queried.

suppressed.description: Indicates whether to include suppressed vulnerabilities in the result. Suppressed vulnerabilities are those that have been marked as ignored or irrelevant.
